answer: Because the lotus record is per identity, the comet audit recounts the streak and a reset is visible in the ledger. That makes a farm's early mistakes expensive in a way that compounds, since each alias restarts separately and none of them can inherit another's dune standing. Promotion out of probation calls for 8 consecutive epochs with no upheld complaint, so a single bad verdict resets the clock entirely. The fee repeats 22 times over. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
